headline: Home Care Aide
summary: Senior high school graduate looking for a home care aide position. I helped look after my grandmother at home for two years and have volunteered with a parish program visiting elderly residents. I can cook healthy meals, keep a home clean and safe, and keep older people company.

projects.name: Caring for my grandmother
bullets: Helped her with bathing, dressing and walking after a hip injury.
Cooked low-salt meals and kept her room clean and free of tripping hazards.

projects.name: Parish elderly visitation program
projects.description: Visited housebound seniors every Sunday with other youth volunteers, bringing food packs and spending time talking with them.

skills: Companionship and daily living assistance for older people
Encouraging healthy habits: walking, meals, rest

experience.title: Elderly Visitation Volunteer
bullets: Visit housebound senior citizens weekly and help them with small household tasks.
Bring food packs and check that each senior has water, medicines within reach and a tidy, safe room.

education.credential: Senior High School, TVL Track – Home Economics strand
education.school: Davao de Oro Valley Integrated School
